purpose: Provide a deterministic page/root-local reconciliation primitive that consumes immutable worker returns, records typed dispositions, detects contradictions and evidence breaches, requests independent verification when warranted, and emits candidate-only integration output without manufacturing Human Accepted, Current or Served authority.

input_contract.return_semantics: Worker RETURNs remain immutable evidence. The local steward derives dispositions and integration candidates separately; it never mutates source RETURNs.

pipeline: verify source return identity and immutable content hash evidence
filter semantic atoms to the declared integration scope
exclude protected-authority self-assertions from candidate evidence
deduplicate semantically equivalent atoms while preserving every source return edge
detect same-scope same-key contradictions without newest-wins
detect changed bytes at an allegedly immutable return path
record a typed disposition per source return
emit explicit independent-verification requests for risk/evidence triggers
emit deterministic candidate-only local integration object
